title: Strict relative birational group law and its group realizations
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $X$ a scheme over $S$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. All products and fibres below are scheme-theoretic [def-pc-base-change]. For a morphism $f:Y\to S$, a subset $A\subseteq Y$ is fibrewise dense if, for every $s\in S$, the inverse image of $A$ in $Y_s$ is topologically dense. A strict birational group law representative on $X$ consists of an $S$-scheme $D$, an open immersion $j:D\to X\times_S X$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and an $S$-morphism $m:D\to X$. The maps $\Phi=(p_1j,m)$ and $\Psi=(m,p_2j)$ from $D$ to $X\times_S X$ are open immersions. Each of the three open images $j(D)$, $\Phi(D)$, $\Psi(D)$ is fibrewise dense for each of $p_1,p_2$. The partial multiplication is associative: for every $S$-scheme $T$, and $a,b,c,d:T\to D$ with $p_2ja=p_1jb$, $p_1jc=ma$, $p_2jc=p_2jb$, $p_1jd=p_1ja$, and $p_2jd=mb$, one has $mc=md$. Thus $a,b,c,d$ represent the four defined products $xy,yz,(xy)z,x(yz)$. Such a representative specifies the strict relative rational law on its chart; different charts representing the same rational law are allowed. A group realization is a group scheme $H$ over $S$ [def-sc-group-scheme], smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], separated (its diagonal is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]), and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], together with an open immersion $i:X\to H$ over $S$ whose image is fibrewise dense for $H\to S$, and such that $i\circ m=\mu_H\circ(i\times_S i)\circ j$.
